extracted.stage: Estate administration; property awaiting sale, IHT due
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a £791,500 illiquid Guildford estate enquires about £145,500 of funding for professional fees and inheritance tax ahead of an HMRC deadline on 20 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Dear Mr Hartley, thank you for your enquiry regarding the Guildford estate and for setting out the figures so clearly. To progress a review we would need confirmation of the grant of probate position, a copy of the estate account or schedule of assets and liabilities, details of the property to be sold including any charges, the identities of the executors and beneficiaries, and the HMRC calculation showing the amount and due date. Please also confirm the proposed security over the estate and your firm's client due diligence details. Once we have those documents a member of our team will review the matter and come back to you. Nothing in this email should be taken as an offer or an indication of terms.
